title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
description: Ten documented Georgia College traditions, from a graduation superstition to annual campus rituals.

cards.title: Avoid the Bobcat Head
cards.subtitle: Front Campus graduation superstition
cards.notes: Find the marble Bobcat Head at Front Campus’s crossroads, take a group photo nearby, and leave its surface alone until your degree is complete.
cards.short_summary: A marble mascot marker with a pre-graduation superstition.
cards.evidence_claim: Georgia College’s Blue Book says students should not step on the Bobcat Head before earning their degree or they will not graduate on time.
cards.source_title: The Georgia College Blue Book: The Traditions and Key Experiences of the Bobcat Nation
cards.access_notes: Outdoor Front Campus landmark; observe the superstition respectfully.

cards.title: Take the Green Towel on the Prowl
cards.subtitle: Bobcat spirit-towel tradition
cards.notes: Use the Green Towel at a spirited university event or photograph it while traveling, then share the image through the university’s stated submission route.
cards.short_summary: A portable green towel used to show Georgia College connection beyond campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Blue Book identifies the Green Towel as both a spirit towel and a traveling towel for Georgia College community members.
cards.source_title: The Georgia College Blue Book: The Traditions and Key Experiences of the Bobcat Nation
cards.access_notes: Bring a towel only if one is provided or obtained through an approved university channel.

cards.title: Wear Blue and Green on Friday
cards.subtitle: Weekly Bobcat-color ritual
cards.notes: Wear Georgia College blue and green on Friday and keep an eye out for Thunder, whose appearance is part of the documented campus tradition.
cards.short_summary: A weekly color-wearing tradition tied to the Bobcat mascot.
cards.evidence_claim: The Blue Book directs community members to wear blue and green every Friday and notes that Thunder may offer a special thank-you.
cards.source_title: The Georgia College Blue Book: The Traditions and Key Experiences of the Bobcat Nation
cards.access_notes: Wear school colors; mascot appearances vary by event.

cards.entity_name: Georgia College Alma Mater and Carillon
cards.title: Listen for the Alma Mater
cards.subtitle: Campus carillon tradition
cards.notes: Pause when the carillon plays the Alma Mater and listen from campus; save the official sheet music if you want to follow the composition.
cards.short_summary: The school song is played by campus chimes on a weekday schedule.
cards.evidence_claim: The Blue Book says the Alma Mater, composed in 1965, is played on the university carillon on weekdays.
cards.source_title: The Georgia College Blue Book: The Traditions and Key Experiences of the Bobcat Nation
cards.access_notes: Carillon timing may change; consult current campus communications before planning around a specific time.

cards.title: Receive the Class Pin at Convocation
cards.subtitle: New-student induction ceremony
cards.notes: If you are an entering student, attend Convocation, receive your class pin, and treat it as the formal marker of joining the Georgia College community.
cards.short_summary: New students receive a class pin during their official induction.
cards.evidence_claim: The Blue Book describes Convocation as students’ official induction and says new students receive a class pin.
cards.source_title: The Georgia College Blue Book: The Traditions and Key Experiences of the Bobcat Nation
cards.access_notes: Participation is associated with entering students; confirm current new-student programming.

cards.title: Form Your Class Year on Front Lawn
cards.subtitle: Weekend of Welcome class-photo tradition
cards.notes: During Weekend of Welcome, join your entering class on Front Lawn to form the digits of the class year for the elevated group photograph.
cards.short_summary: Each entering class forms its year numerals on the lawn for a commemorative photo.
cards.evidence_claim: The Blue Book says each entering class forms the digits of its class year on the front lawn during Weekend of Welcome.
cards.source_title: The Georgia College Blue Book: The Traditions and Key Experiences of the Bobcat Nation
cards.access_notes: For entering students during Weekend of Welcome; follow event staff directions.

cards.title: Bag Potatoes for Local Distribution
cards.subtitle: Annual fall service activity
cards.notes: Register through the GIVE Center when the fall Potato Drop is announced, then help bag donated potatoes for distribution to local community organizations.
cards.short_summary: A large annual volunteer effort that redirects potatoes to local recipients.
cards.evidence_claim: The Blue Book identifies Potato Drop as an annual fall signature service activity, with volunteers bagging potatoes for local organizations.
cards.source_title: The Georgia College Blue Book: The Traditions and Key Experiences of the Bobcat Nation
cards.access_notes: Annual scheduling and volunteer registration should be confirmed with the GIVE Center.

cards.title: Watch Front Campus Light Up
cards.subtitle: Pre-exam holiday-lighting tradition
cards.notes: Join the Front Lawn gathering before fall exams to watch the named historic halls light up, and enjoy the holiday music and refreshments if offered.
cards.short_summary: A Student Government Association holiday lighting of Front Campus halls.
cards.evidence_claim: The Blue Book says the Student Government Association invites campus to Front Lawn for the pre-exam lighting of five halls.
cards.source_title: The Georgia College Blue Book: The Traditions and Key Experiences of the Bobcat Nation
cards.access_notes: Annual pre-exam event; verify current date and weather plans with Student Government Association.

cards.title: See Greek Weekend Competition
cards.subtitle: Annual Fraternity and Sorority Life event
cards.notes: Attend publicly available Greek Weekend programming to watch chapter competitions such as the Step/Stroll Show and Greek Sing, following event guidance.
cards.short_summary: Chapters compete and celebrate academic and philanthropic work in an annual April program.
cards.evidence_claim: The Blue Book describes Greek Weekend as an annual April Georgia College Fraternity and Sorority Life event with chapter competitions.
cards.source_title: The Georgia College Blue Book: The Traditions and Key Experiences of the Bobcat Nation
cards.access_notes: Audience access and schedule vary; check current Fraternity and Sorority Life announcements.

cards.title: Celebrate at Lavender Graduation
cards.subtitle: Annual LGBTQ+ graduating-student recognition
cards.notes: If eligible, connect with the appropriate campus office about Lavender Graduation; allies can support participating graduates according to the current event guidance.
cards.short_summary: An annual recognition celebrating graduating LGBTQ+ students and allies.
cards.evidence_claim: The Blue Book says Lavender Graduation is held annually for graduating LGBTQ+ students and allies and first occurred at Georgia College in 2012.
cards.source_title: The Georgia College Blue Book: The Traditions and Key Experiences of the Bobcat Nation
cards.access_notes: Confirm current eligibility, registration, and guest arrangements with the organizing campus office.
